import json,random
random.seed(1)
for trial in range(2):
    P=random.choice([1,2,3]); R=random.choice([1,1,2]); D=random.choice([0,1,1,2])
    inp=[[[random.randint(-3,3) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for _ in range(P)]
    n=random.randint(1,5)
    states=[]
    for i in range(n):
        dl=[]
        for r in range(P):
            k=random.randint(0,R)
            dl.append([[random.randint(-5,5) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(k)])
        c=random.random()
        if c<0.4:
            dl=[]
            for r in range(P):
                k=random.randint(0,R)
                dl.append([[sum(inp[x][q][i] for x in range(P)) for i in range(D)] for q in range(k)])
        sl=[]
        for _ in range(random.randint(0,2)):
            if R==0: break
            rq=random.randrange(R)
            ranks=sorted(random.sample(range(P), random.randint(0,P)))
            ssum=[sum(inp[r][rq][i] for r in ranks) for i in range(D)]
            if random.random()<0.3: ssum=[x+1 for x in ssum]
            sl.append({"seq":rq,"ranks":list(ranks),"sum":ssum})
        states.append({"delivered":dl,"slots":sl})
    if trial==1:
        print("P,R,D,n",P,R,D,n,"inp",json.dumps(inp))
        for st in states: print(json.dumps(st))
